description: This file defines Perl module 'Git::SVN::Prompt' providing authentication callback functions for SVN, specifically tailored for integration with git-svn. It implements functions for handling username prompts, SSL certificate verification, and password inputs, used to facilitate SVN authentication prompts within a git-svn context.

methods.name: simple
methods.description: Handles simple username/password authentication prompt, setting credentials based on provided defaults or user input.

methods.name: ssl_server_trust
methods.description: Handles SSL server trust validation, informing user of certificate validation failures and prompting for acceptance.

methods.name: ssl_client_cert
methods.description: Prompts for and sets the client SSL certificate file.

methods.name: ssl_client_cert_pw
methods.description: Prompts for and sets the client SSL certificate password.

methods.name: username
methods.description: Prompts for and sets the username credential.

methods.name: _read_password
methods.description: Reads a password input from the user securely.
